title: Hook events: tool calls and permissions
description: Event arrays (`hookEvent_<Event>`) and matcher groups (`hookMatcherGroup_<Event>`) for: PreToolUse, PermissionRequest, PermissionDenied, PostToolUse, PostToolUseFailure, PostToolBatch.

hookEvent_PreToolUse.title: PreToolUse
hookEvent_PreToolUse.description: Before a tool call executes. Can allow, deny, ask, defer, or rewrite the call.

hookMatcherGroup_PreToolUse.description: Matcher group for PreToolUse: an optional matcher plus the handlers to run when it applies. Handlers allowed here: command, http, mcp_tool, prompt or agent.

matcher.description: Filters on the tool name (any tool except EndConversation). Evaluation: `*`, an empty string, or an omitted matcher matches everything; a value made only of letters, digits, `_`, `-`, spaces, `,` and `|` is an exact string or a `|`/`,`-separated list of exact strings; any other character makes it an unanchored JavaScript regular expression (RegExp.test). MCP tools are named `mcp__<server>__<tool>`; end a server prefix with `.*` (`mcp__memory__.*`) to match all its tools; plugin-bundled MCP servers use `mcp__plugin_<plugin>_<server>__<tool>`.
matcher.title: Matcher

hooks.description: Hook handlers to run when the matcher applies; all matching handlers run in parallel and identical handlers from several settings files run once.
hooks.title: Hooks

hookEvent_PermissionRequest.title: PermissionRequest
hookEvent_PermissionRequest.description: When a tool call needs a permission decision. Agent hooks are not supported here.

hookEvent_PostToolBatch.title: PostToolBatch
hookEvent_PostToolBatch.description: After a full batch of parallel tool calls resolves, before the next model call.

hookMatcherGroup_PostToolBatch.description: Matcher group for PostToolBatch: an optional matcher plus the handlers to run when it applies. Handlers allowed here: command, http, mcp_tool, prompt or agent. The `if` field is not evaluated on this event, so a handler that sets it never runs.

matcher.description: PostToolBatch has no matcher support: the field is accepted but silently ignored and the group fires on every occurrence. Omit it.
